segments.text: What: The first scored checkpoint — a full mock interview that forces you to combine everything from Phase 1 (estimation, networking, caching, relational basics) under real time pressure.
How to complete: Sit the mock cold, timed to 45 minutes, then score yourself against: estimation, hashing, cache design, read-heavy scale.

Don't move on until you can truthfully check off:
Size any system to ±1 order of magnitude in <5 min
Trace an HTTP request browser→DB→browser without notes
